page.layout: Top: two medallions side by side, each with a portrait and a circular legend (left: BRVTVS; right: IGNOGNE and VX·BRVTI). Below them: one column of running text, two paragraphs. Ornament at the foot (not printed text, omitted).

main_text.l: BRVTVS
IGNOGNE
VX·BRVTI
BRVTVS Ascanij Æneæ filij ex Syluio nepos(quanquam
alij censeant Syluium Æneæ filium Posthumum fuisse ) fertur
proceros quosdam, atque immanes viros sede sua expulisse:
insulamque eam de suo nomine Britanniam cognominasse,
quæ prius vocabatur Albion, ab Albina quadam Syriæ regis
filia, quæ vna cum 32. fororibus, interfectis ab se viris, à patre
expulsa, in hæc loco appulerat. Post annos circiter 50. ab exci-
dio Troiæ, id est circa annum à mundo condito 2832. ante
Christum natum 1130. cœpit in ea insula,quam magnam Bri-
tanniam vocant, regnare Brutus iste, illicque fertur liberos
genuisse tres, qui totidem sibi regna constituerunt: Locrum à
quo Locria:Cambrum à quo Cambra, nunc Vuallia: & Alba-
nactum, à quo Albania,quæ Scotia postea dicta est.Locrus fra-
tribus superstes, solus Britannia potitus est: post quem Mad-
dan annos quadraginta regnauit. hæc Raphaël Volaterranus
in Geographia,lib.3. de populis ac regibus Britanniæ, quam
nunc Angliam vocant. Supputationem annorum potes etiam
colligere,ac deprehendere in Ascanio Æneę filio,de quo à no-
bis dictum est supra,paulò antè, tertia ab hinc pagina.
IGNOGNE Pandrasi Leo-græciæ Regis filia,huius Bru-
ti vxor fuit, ex qua tres, qui supradicti sunt, liberos sustulit.
Videto Supplementum Chroni.lib.4. Item Chronica Chroni-
corum.

page.notes: Medallion legends are set in a circle; their reading order and the letters of "VX·BRVTI" and "IGNOGNE" are read from the scan and may be uneven: "VX·BRVTI" is partly cut by the medallion edge, so the final letters are uncertain. Some numbers are set with spaces or old-style zeros in the print (for example "3 2.", "5 o.", "2 8 3 2.", "1 1 3 o."); they are given here as their values. The page ends with a printer's ornament at the foot, which is not text and is omitted.
